description.en: Adds one or more party members with a full "new member joined" presentation: optionally fades out/stops the current BGM, waits, then for each member plays a jingle, shows the recruitment message, calls AddParty, and waits for the jingle to finish, before restoring the BGM. This is the general engine behind all the AddParty_Message/AddPartyNum_Message convenience wrappers.
Number of members to add (length of the following array arguments).
Array of param IDs, one per member to add.
Array of position-lock flags, one per member.
Array of avatar-enable flags, one per member.
Array of avatar-lock flags, one per member.
Array of levels to set, one per member (-1 to leave unchanged).
BGM fade-out duration in frames before the sequence; a negative value skips fading/stopping the BGM entirely.
Number of frames to wait after the BGM fade before starting.
Jingle sound event ID to play for each added member.
Unused by this implementation (kept for signature compatibility).
Message ID shown via CreateSpeech for each added member.
No explicit return statement — Squirrel functions implicitly return null.

example.code:
// Add one party member with a jingle and recruitment message (as AddParty_Message does)
AddParty_MessageEx(1, ["para_cp0015"], [true], [false], [false], [18], 30, 30, "J_08", 0, "sysmes-add_party");
